name: Google Pub/Sub
label: Google Cloud Pub/Sub REST v1
description: Official Cloud Pub/Sub REST v1 at https://pubsub.googleapis.com. topic.publish POST /v1/projects/{projectId}/topics/{topic}:publish; subscription.pull POST /v1/projects/{projectId}/subscriptions/{subscription}:pull; trigger.listen is kind ingress (BPMN message event — not StreamingPull, not a public push URL). Auth Bearer oauth_access_token. Customer owns the GCP project. Never log the token or message data. Docs: https://cloud.google.com/pubsub/docs/reference/rest
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: Per-operation fields. Do not put oauth_access_token here. Example: {"operation":"topic.publish","topic":"orders","messages":[{"data":"<base64>"}]}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Overrides config operation when non-blank. EXACT: topic.publish | subscription.pull | trigger.listen. trigger.listen is ingress (BPMN message event), not HTTP. Do not put oauth_access_token here. Example: 'topic.publish'.

schema.label: topic
schema.description: Topic id (not the full resource name). Path {topic}.

schema.label: messages
schema.description: Official PubsubMessage array. Each data must be Base64. Optional attributes, orderingKey.

schema.label: maxMessages
schema.description: Unary pull batch size. Official required positive integer. Default 1 if omitted server-side may 400 — send a number.

schema.label: Return immediately
schema.description: PullRequest.returnImmediately. subscription.pull. true returns even when the backlog is empty (discouraged).

ports.name: output
ports.description: Success: status=ok, http_status, data (provider JSON). Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when input.operation is blank. EXACT: topic.publish | subscription.pull | trigger.listen.

configurationParameters.label: OAuth access token
configurationParameters.description: Google OAuth 2.0 access token. Sent as Authorization: Bearer. StudioQuack secret. Never on INPUT. Operator-supplied; this node does not run an OAuth UI or JWT grant.

configurationParameters.label: Project ID
configurationParameters.description: GCP project id in the resource path projects/{projectId}/…

configurationParameters.label: Default topic
configurationParameters.description: Default topic id (not the full name) when INPUT topic is empty. topic.publish.

configurationParameters.label: Default subscription
configurationParameters.description: Default subscription id when INPUT subscription is empty. subscription.pull.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Per-request HTTP timeout. Positive number; <=0 → 25. Keep below the daemon invoke budget.
